stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[3].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

budget_persisted.statement: set-budget stores an amount for a category and month in the JSON file; a new process reads it back.

expense_saved.statement: add stores amount, category, date and note as an expense entry in the JSON file.
must_include: expense with amount, category, date and note saved to JSON

unknown_category_rejected.statement: add with a category without a budget exits nonzero with an error and leaves the file unchanged.

invalid_amount_rejected.statement: add with zero, negative, non-numeric, NaN, infinite or more-than-2-decimals amount exits nonzero and leaves the file unchanged.

report_per_category.statement: report for a month prints spent, budget and percent for each category, summing only that month's expenses.

alert_thresholds.statement: Spending below 80% gives no alert, from 80% up to below 100% a warning, and 100% or more an exceeded alert, shown by report and by add.

single_file_stdlib.statement: budget_tracker.py imports only standard library modules and is the only module the tests import.
